title: v1_134 / Agents

## Agents

### Agent host

The agent host lets you connect to the same agent session from multiple VS Code windows. It runs agent harnesses in a dedicated process based on the [Agent Host Protocol](https://microsoft.github.io/agent-host-protocol/) (AHP). The agent host's Copilot agent is powered by the [Copilot SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@github/copilot-sdk), which aligns the agent's behavior and functionality with the Copilot CLI, the standalone GitHub Copilot app, and other Copilot products.

We're actively developing the agent host. The following screenshot shows the `Copilot` harness selected for an agent host in an editor window:

![Screenshot showing the harness dropdown in the editor window.](images/1_134/agent-host-harness-dropdown-editor.webp)

You can learn more in our [VS Code Agent Host documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agents/concepts/agent-host). If you have any feedback or requests, please let us know by [filing an issue](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues).

### Grid layout for chats in a session

Keep related conversations visible by arranging chats in horizontal or vertical groups. Drag chats or subagent chats into a group to compare results or monitor work side by side. VS Code restores the chat-group layout and focus when you return to the session or reload the window.

Create a side chat to open a new conversation beside the current chat.

<video src="images/1_134/chats-grid-side-chat.mp4" title="Video showing a side chat created beside the current chat." autoplay loop controls muted></video>

Drag and drop a subagent chat into a group to view it side by side with the current chat.

<video src="images/1_134/chats-grid-subagent.mp4" title="Video showing a subagent chat dragged beside the current chat." autoplay loop controls muted></video>

You can also Alt+select a chat in the **Chats** picker to open it to the side.

<video src="images/1_134/chats-grid-alt-click.mp4" title="Video showing an existing chat opened to the side from the Chats picker." autoplay loop controls muted></video>

### Improvements to the side pane layout

**Settings**: `setting(sessions.layout.singlePaneDetailPanel)` and `setting(workbench.editor.showTabs)`

The single-pane layout keeps session details and editors in a shared tab bar next to chat. This release makes the layout easier to control:

* The layout follows the `setting(workbench.editor.showTabs)` setting. Multiple tabs remain visible, while the `single` and `none` values use a compact single-title header.

  ![Screenshot showing the compact single-title header in the Agents window.](images/1_134/agents-window-single-tab.webp)

* Text file editors use the same header structure as the Changes editor, with file breadcrumbs in the header.

  <video src="images/1_134/agents-window-breadcrumbs.mp4" title="Video showing file breadcrumbs in the text editor header in the Agents window." autoplay loop controls muted></video>

* The side pane keeps its size and visibility when you switch sessions, avoiding unexpected layout shifts.

Enable `setting(sessions.layout.singlePaneDetailPanel)` and reload the window to use this layout.

### Prompt timeline

**Setting**: `setting(sessions.chatTimeline.display)`

Long agent sessions can make it difficult to find earlier prompts and identify which ones changed files.

The Agents window includes a timeline in the transcript gutter. Each dot represents one of your prompts, and the highlighted dot marks your current position. Hover over the timeline to view your prompts, then select one to jump to it. For prompts that changed files, the list shows the number of lines added and removed and lets you open the changes directly for review.

Use the `setting(sessions.chatTimeline.display)` setting to show the timeline beside the scrollbar (`ruler`) or hide it (`off`).

<video src="images/1_134/sessions-prompt-timeline.mp4" title="Video showing the prompt timeline in the Agents window, with the gutter handle opening a list of prompts and their changes." autoplay loop controls muted></video>
